clips.title: The story
paras: Beldin Steelgrill asks you to investigate a fire on the heights above Gol'Bolar Quarry. Mountaineers have spotted a stranger's camp, and the dwarves want to know whether the visitor threatens them.

A strange fire has appeared above Gol'Bolar Quarry, drawing concern in Kharanos. Dun Morogh's mountaineers watch the crags and snowy valleys around Ironforge, and an unfamiliar camp on the heights is hard to ignore. Beldin Steelgrill asks you to climb the ridge and learn whether the stranger above the dwarven excavation means harm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... Well, you know what to do.
